data.long_meaning: Minne is a German name derived from the Old High German word minna, meaning 'love' or 'friendship'. It was a popular name among the Germanic peoples and was also used in the Middle Ages. In Christian tradition, Minne represents the divine love that God has for His people and the love that Christians should have for one another.
